run_crr_offline_rl_training: run a CRR offline RL training loop on D4RL mujoco locomotion datasets using JAX
create_crr_learner: create a CRRLearner with policy and critic optimizers for offline reinforcement learning
build_crr_networks: build policy and critic networks from an environment spec using crr.make_networks
